title: Ocean Friends

poem.title: Eight Waving Arms
poem.text:
Eight gentle arms in the shimmering sea,
Waving a watery hello to me,
Then curling close beside a stone.

Through coral gardens, soft and bright,
The octopus glides out of sight,
And finds a quiet cave called home.

activity.text: Draw an octopus and count all eight arms.

creatures.illustrationBrief: A friendly octopus waving among colorful coral.
creatures.altText: A smiling octopus with eight visible arms near a coral reef.

poem.title: Seagrass Sailor
poem.text:
Flippers glide where sea grasses sway,
A turtle cruises through the day,
Across the ocean blue.

It rises gently for some air,
Then travels onward without care,
With silver bubbles too.

funFact.text: Green sea turtles are named for the greenish color of fat beneath their shells.

activity.text: Trace a large oval shell and fill it with repeating patterns.

creatures.illustrationBrief: A green sea turtle swimming over seagrass.
creatures.altText: A green sea turtle gliding above a meadow of seagrass.

poem.title: Clownfish Hideaway
poem.text:
Orange and white in a garden bright,
A clownfish darts and slips from sight,
Among the waving green.

It peeks outside, then turns around,
And dances softly without sound,
The quickest fish we've seen.

funFact.text: Clownfish live among the tentacles of sea anemones.

activity.text: Color a clownfish using an orange, white, and black pattern.

creatures.illustrationBrief: A clownfish peeking from a sea anemone.
creatures.altText: An orange-and-white clownfish among an anemone's tentacles.

poem.title: Dolphin in the Foam
poem.text:
Up through the sparkle, over the foam,
A dolphin whistles on its way home,
Then dives beneath the spray.

It races where the bright waves gleam,
And leaps as lightly as a dream,
Before it swims away.

funFact.text: Dolphins breathe air through a blowhole on top of the head.

activity.text: Draw a curved wave and add a dolphin leaping above it.

creatures.illustrationBrief: A bottlenose dolphin leaping above a gentle wave.
creatures.altText: A gray bottlenose dolphin jumping over a blue wave.

poem.title: Curly-Tail Dance
poem.text:
A curly tail holds on so tight,
A seahorse bobs in morning light,
Beside the grasses green.

It rocks along the gentle tide,
With tiny fins on either side,
A dancer small and keen.

funFact.text: Male seahorses carry developing young in a pouch.

activity.text: Use a spiral line to draw a seahorse's curled tail.

creatures.illustrationBrief: A golden seahorse holding seagrass with its curled tail.
creatures.altText: A small golden seahorse wrapped around a strand of seagrass.

closingNote: Keep wondering about the amazing creatures in our oceans!
